policy.exactDuplicateMeaning: Same normalized semantic selector family, same at-rule/layer context, and same ordered declarations across at least two CSS files.
policy.structuralDuplicateMeaning: Same normalized semantic selector family and context with identical non-theme declarations; palette, background, border, shadow, filter, radius, opacity and custom-property values may differ and require family review.
policy.intentionalLocalMeaning: Game-stage/canvas/board/overlay and responsive contracts are hard-local; unmatched rules remain local until a reviewed family proves otherwise.
